note: Custer Gallatin NF campground in Hyalite Canyon ~12 mi south of Bozeman, mostly in open meadows along Hyalite Creek, some sites under pine and fir; Hyalite Reservoir is 3.5 mi up the paved canyon road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on recreation.gov, no hookups, vault toilets/drinking water, no dump, $26/night (2026 rate table). Changed max_rig_ft 32 -> 45 (catalog).
